items.text:
I was clear about this being a WIP and not the finished product but was struck by the unique theme and sci-fi setting. My curiosity was to much and I was happy to help support the team with this project and hope all their plans for it come to fruition.
Sure it is still a little clunky but with more funding and time I'm hoping this really grows in theme and that the game play expands.
items.text_zh:
我很清楚这是一个开发中的作品，不是成品，但还是被它独特的主题和科幻设定所吸引。我的好奇心太强了，我很乐意帮助支持团队的这个项目，并希望他们所有的计划都能实现。
当然，它现在还有点笨拙，但有了更多的资金和时间，我希望它真的能在主题上成长，游戏玩法也能扩展。

observations.description: 游戏操作/机制仍有些笨拙
observations.evidence: Sure it is still a little clunky
